title: BMX Bike
description:
A BMX you actually ride. Lean to steer, pedal up the ramps, grind rails and ledges, flip, and land it. Calm and planted like the Tony Hawk games, with real physics underneath.

RIDING
- Steering comes from leaning, the way a real bike turns. The bike stays upright to gravity, so crossing a bank or climbing a ramp at an angle does not tip you over.
- Pedal up transitions and funbox ramps. A vert wall still needs a run-up.
- Suspension that soaks up landings, kerbs you can roll up, and ledges that stop you instead of throwing you.

TRICKS
- Wheelies, manuals, stoppies, bunny hops, front flips, back flips, barrel rolls and 360s, all scored with on-screen callouts.
- Grinds, found automatically on any map: hop onto a pipe for a Crank Grind (the rail runs under the middle of the bike, wheels either side), or onto a ledge or coping edge for a Double Peg Grind. Sparks and scrape included. No map setup needed.
- Hands-off landings line up with the slope you are coming down on.

LOOKS
- A full procedural bike: painted frame, real tyres, chrome pegs, chainring, and pedals geared to the rear wheel.
- The rider sits on the saddle, hands closed on the grips, feet on the pedals, and crashes as a ragdoll of their own player model.
- 14 paint colours. The one you pick is the one your next bike spawns in.
- A GTA-style cinematic camera that keeps filming through a crash.

CONTROLS
E  get on (picks up a fallen bike)
W / S  pedal / rear brake   (in the air: nose down / nose up)
A / D  lean to steer   (in the air: roll)
SPACE  hold and release to hop; tap to hop off a grind
Right mouse  weight back: wheelie or manual
Left mouse  front brake: stoppie
SHIFT  sprint   CTRL  tuck
K  next paint colour (puff of smoke)   L  cinematic camera
Hold C and right-click a bike: pick any colour

CONSOLE
bmx_spawn  spawn a bike (or find BMX in the Entities tab)
bmx_color <name>  paint your bike
bmx_debug 1  live physics telemetry
bmx_lod_scale  bike detail by distance (0 = always full)

Base Garry's Mod only: nothing to mount, no content from other games. Server-authoritative, works in singleplayer and on servers. MIT licensed.
